facts: No external PostgreSQL network driver exists in this crate.
The embedded migration SQL forces row-level security through winwincode.scope_key.
The package directly depends on audit, backup, domain, and the combined storage crate.
The implementation performs bounded verified-TLS HTTP and multipart/range operations.
It uses Bearer workload credentials and mandatory aws:kms response/request headers rather than a product-neutral credential and encryption policy.
It directly depends on audit, backup, domain, and the combined storage crate.
Neutral telemetry types, aggregation, trace, and alert logic share one file with the SQLite schema and adapter.
The package directly depends on rusqlite.
There is no PostgreSQL store or external telemetry exporter in this crate.
The framework supports GitHub, Jira, Linear, Slack, Teams, and generic webhooks.
The public model uses EnterpriseIntegrationId and tenant-scoped AuditScope.
The durable framework and Slack rate-limit state directly use SQLite.
Provider files combine reusable protocol code with credentials, endpoint/TLS configuration, and product-named connectors.

splitOrder: First extract storage, audit, backup, publication, identity, and scope ports required by the neutral packages.
Then split the four current crates into neutral optional packages and Community-only SQLite adapters without copying product configuration.
Publish one immutable optional-infrastructure release with exact version, source commit, SHA-256, SBOM, and license manifest.
After each target repository exists, add Cloud Hosted compositions and Enterprise customer compositions against the pinned neutral release.
Run real PostgreSQL, object-store, observability, connector, restart, isolation, secret-scan, and cross-repository path-dependency gates.
Delete the superseded combined crate paths after all three owners pass their tests; do not retain aliases or parallel runtime paths.
